newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ABN AMRO starts AmeriTrade as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ABN AMRO starts AmeriTrade as buy.

text.p: ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said analyst Scott Appleby started coverage of AmeriTrade Holding Corp with a buy. --Said AmeriTrade, as a pioneer of online trading, is "well-positioned to benefit" from technological, behavioral changes stemming from the Internet. --Projected net revenues to expand at 20-25 percent compound annual growth rate over the next three years. It expects the firm's earnings to rise "only slightly" this year as the company invested in its brand but expects earnings per share to grow at 20-25 percent rate over the following three years.
--Said AMTD shares are trading at "significant discount" to its peers and set a 12-month target price range of $25, a 40 percent potential appreciation.
--ABM AMRO estimates the company's 1997 earnings per share at $0.93 and its 1998 earnings at $1.15 a share.

"We expect the company to continue to experience significant growth through consolidating its multiple brand strategy and increasing its marketing budget by 40-plus percent from $14 million to $20 million," Appleby wrote in a research note.
Shares of AmeriTrade traded at 19-1/4, up 1-3/8.
